newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber prices seen lower in 1997 - MIER.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber prices seen lower in 1997 - MIER.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices are expected to be moderate in 1997 and 1998 after a higher trend this year, the Malaysian Institute of Economic Research (MIER) said on Tuesday.

The benchmark Ribbed Smoke Sheet 1 (RSS1) is expected to average 365 cents ($1.44) a kg in 1996 and moderate to 360 cents and 345 cents in 1997 and 1998, respectively, said the government-backed institute in a review of the country's various economic sectors.
The RSS1 averaged 393.61 cents a kg during the whole of 1995.

Lower export volumes and prices led to a 15.7 percent fall in earnings from rubber for the first nine months of 1996, compared to a rise of 57.1 percent seen during the same period of 1995, MIER said.
